nudges.text: Groom the Backlog: re-rank by value, finish started features first, add unboarded issues, check No Status.
End of the workday. Summarise the last 12 hours to the operator, list every Blocked card, then run: company reboot --workday

Staffing review: run `company load`. Hire where a column is backing up (Ready deep → developer; QA deep → qa-tester; In Review deep → a reviewer), fire an employee idle for the whole window, within maxAgents. Then one line to the operator: what you changed and why, or 'no change' and why.
